title: 特殊疑问词 How/What/Where
intro: 8 页精讲：How often/long/many/much/old · What/Where/When/Why · 答句匹配
psleNote: PSLE 疑问词考点 133+ 处，How often 与 How long 易混。

examples.en: How often do you go to the library? Twice a week.
examples.zh: 你多久去一次图书馆？一周两次。

examples.en: How long did you watch TV last night? About two hours.
examples.zh: 昨晚你看了多久电视？大约两小时。

examples.en: How many books do you have? Five.
How much does the goldfish weigh? About 200 grams.
examples.zh: 这条金鱼多重？大约 200 克。

examples.en: Where is the post office? It's near my home.
examples.zh: 邮局在哪里？在我家附近。

examples.en: What do you want to be? I want to be a doctor.
examples.zh: 你想成为什么？我想当医生。

examples.en: When is your birthday? It's in May.
examples.zh: 你的生日是什么时候？在五月。

examples.en: Why are you late? Because I missed the bus.
examples.zh: 你为什么迟到？因为我错过了公交车。

pages.title: 苏格拉底 · 考点在哪？
pages.question: Twice a week 回答的是哪个疑问词？

choices.fb: How long 答 for two hours 等。
How many 答具体数字+可数名词。

pages.sentence: —How often do you go to the library? —Twice a week.
pages.zh: —你多久去一次图书馆？—一周两次。

pages.title: 规则发现
pages.leftSentence: How often do you exercise? —Every day.
pages.rightSentence: How long did you watch TV? —Two hours.
pages.rightZh: 你看了多久电视？—两小时。
pages.discovery: How often → 频率；How long → 时长；How many/much → 数量。

rules.rule: How often 频率；How long 时长；How many 可数；How much 不可数
rules.sample: How often do you go to the library? Twice a week.
rules.sampleZh: 你多久去一次图书馆？一周两次。

rules.rule: What 什么；Where 哪里；When 何时；Why 为什么
rules.sample: Where do you live? I live in Chengdu.
